seoTitle: Audio Reverser: Play Any Sound Backwards
metaDescription: Reverse an audio file so it plays backwards, preview it and download the WAV. Free online audio reverser that runs in your browser.
intro: Plays an audio clip in reverse and saves the reversed version as a WAV file.
why:
Reversed sound is a classic effect: reverse cymbals build up to a hit, backward vocals add an eerie layer, and some people reverse speech to hear how it sounds. It is also a quick way to check a loop for clicks, because the seam is easy to hear backwards.

The tool decodes the file with your browser, flips the samples of every channel and writes a WAV. Nothing is uploaded and no sound quality is lost beyond what the decoder gave.
howTo: Play the result in the preview.

faq.a: Yes. Both channels are reversed together.

faq.q: Can I reverse only a part?
faq.a: Cut the part first with the audio trimmer, reverse it, then join it back with the joiner.

faq.q: Why is the file larger than my MP3?

faq.a: Only your browser memory. Several minutes of audio is fine.
